<Image src="data:image/png;base64," width="1376" height="759" />

## Step

1. Navigate to Analytics, view overall performance across all passes.

- Check page views, installs, redemptions, and conversion rate.

- Track user journey (views → installs → redemptions) and engagement over time.

<Image src="data:image/png;base64," width="685" height="405" />

2. Compare pass type distribution and engagement data, see best-performing passes.

<Image src="data:image/png;base64," width="551" height="467" />
